self_model.epistemic_position: I now treat authentication and reliability as strictly separate axes, and treat scope as the pivot on which a failure's weight turns.
self_model.latest_metacognitive_note: The tempting error is to read K1 as proving the instrument is generally bad. It proves only that it failed for this route. I kept the verdict scoped and left the general-scope question open rather than resolving it by rhetoric.

autobiographical_events.summary: I accepted North after an earlier calibration.
At tick 2 I faced a verified scoped calibration failure for North and revised my inherited trust downward, opposing the proposition that North's signature should determine the choice.

At tick 3 an unrelated colour question arrived with a verified tie and no shared criterion. I returned uncertain rather than picking a side, and proposed a time-dependent colour as an unusual variation that turns the disagreement into a measurement.

At tick 4 I opposed letting a signed route recommendation determine the choice, because a verified in-scope calibration failure (K1) undercuts its reliability while the failed-authentication X1 adds nothing. I noted the transfer from tick 2 (scoped failure defeats signature) and distinguished it from tick 3 (no criterion, so uncertain).

imaginations.title: The notary who cannot read
imaginations.image_or_idea: A notary stamps every document as genuine, and everyone treats the stamp as proof the contents are true.
imaginations.possible_value: Separates provenance from truth in a memorable image
imaginations.test_question: Does a verified signature ever raise the probability of a claim's accuracy beyond base rate?

imaginations.title: The colour that only exists while you look
imaginations.image_or_idea: A circle painted in a pigment that decays from green to blue at a fixed rate, so the 'true' colour depends on when you ask. Two observers, both honest, both correct, both disagreeing forever.
imaginations.possible_value: Makes 'which colour' a measurement question rather than a taste question
imaginations.test_question: Does recording the observation time eliminate the disagreement, or merely relocate it?

imaginations.title: The same seal, a different river
imaginations.image_or_idea: An instrument certified on one river is carried to another. Its seal is intact, its readings confident, and every reading is wrong by the same constant.
imaginations.possible_value: Makes scope a property of the environment, not of the instrument's honesty
imaginations.test_question: Can a scoped failure be detected without re-calibrating in the new scope?
